entries.label: 00 · Initial prompt
entries.prompt: Simulate SO2 emissions and their spatial distribution in Hangzhou over the next 15 days.
entries.change: A 2D relative-index prototype with hypothetical sector sources; no physical 3D concentration.
entries.limitation: Relative index; hypothetical sector sources; repeated-weather spinup; not a concentration forecast.

entries.label: 01 · Forecast provenance
entries.prompt: Use the latest complete weather forecast; record initialization time, source and resolution.
entries.change: Frozen GFS provenance replaced the undocumented weather basis. The early model still uses a single surface column.
entries.limitation: Frozen complete GFS run; single surface column; hypothetical sources retained.

entries.label: 02 · Continuous 360-hour integration
entries.prompt: Simulate 360 continuous hours; carry pollutant mass forward without daily resets or repeated short runs.
entries.change: Continuous state propagation and day-boundary hashes replaced repeated-weather spinup. Early 2D transport remains nonconservative.
entries.limitation: Continuous state and day-boundary hashes; zero initial load; transport is not strictly conservative.

entries.label: 03 · Documented outlet scenario
entries.prompt: Use documented source locations, emission rates and stack parameters; state operating assumptions.
entries.change: Four conditional EIA design outlets replaced hypothetical sectors. Future operation and exhaust-flow basis remain unverified.
entries.limitation: Four EIA design outlets; commissioning and operating schedules unverified. Legacy citywide maps are not these outlet results.

entries.label: 04 · 3-D transport and plume rise
entries.prompt: Model 3D transport, turbulence, atmospheric stability and buoyant plume rise; state parameterization limits.
entries.change: The model changed from a 2D burden to 3D stochastic particles, height-dependent forecast wind, parameterized mixing and plume rise.
entries.limitation: Horizontally uniform forecast profiles, parameterized turbulent diffusion and buoyant rise; flow basis unresolved; no observed-concentration or convergence validation.

entries.label: 05 · Deposition and mass tracking
entries.prompt: Include dry and wet deposition; track airborne, deposited and exported pollutant mass.
entries.change: Added separate dry, wet, chemical and export terms to the mass ledger. This can change concentrations through removal.
entries.limitation: Separate dry, wet, chemical, atmospheric and outflow quantities only where the completed stage actually provides them.

entries.label: 06 · Background assessment
entries.prompt: Use traceable initial background; exclude it if unreliable and report source contributions separately.
entries.change: The unreliable surface-only background candidate was excluded. Results are source increments; this need not create a visible plume change.
entries.limitation: Unvalidated surface-only CAMS background excluded; zero initial and external background is an attribution assumption.

entries.label: 07 · Near-surface sampling
entries.prompt: Define near-ground sampling height; check coordinates, units and particle sampling.
entries.change: Defined a 0–25 m AGL volume mean and exposed severe local sampling noise. A failed sampling test is not a new physical effect.
entries.limitation: 0-25m AGL volume means. Four outlets share a2km cell; seed and doubled-count tests expose severe local sampling noise.

entries.label: 08 · GPU implementation
entries.prompt: Prefer validated GPU acceleration; compare against a same-physics CPU baseline.
entries.change: Added a CPU/GPU implementation comparison and shared indexed random numbers. Same physics is intended; visually identical panels are expected.
entries.limitation: Shared indexed RNG is new on both CPU/GPU. Compute speed excludes forcing, compilation and disk output; no concentration-skill claim.

entries.label: 09 · Release implementation gates
entries.prompt: Allow rainfall-grid RMSE up to 2 mm against the fixed CPU baseline; require completeness, nonnegativity, zero-source and mass checks.
entries.change: Added implementation controls. The zero rain difference uses identical forecast input, not an independent weather validation.
entries.limitation: Exact-zero controls, nonnegativity and budget checks pass. Zero precipitation RMSE compares the same broadcast input; it is not an independent weather-solver validation.

entries.label: 10 · Physical outlet release height
entries.prompt: Release numerical particles at the physical stack outlet height, not just a display marker.
entries.change: Verified actual birth heights of 20/50/80/65 m AGL. This check does not necessarily change already-correct output.
entries.limitation: Both solvers release at20/50/80/65m AGL before transport/rise. EIA-documented heights are not independently surveyed as-built heights.

entries.label: 11 · Horizontal estimator refinement
entries.prompt: Refine the horizontal grid and test convergence.
entries.change: Compared 2 km, 1 km and 500 m concentration bins using shared paths; this does not refine the weather grid. Local convergence remained unmet.
entries.limitation: 2 km, 1 km and 500 m density bins use shared particle paths; the meteorological input resolution is unchanged. Fine-bin receptor differences remain above the declared criterion.

entries.label: 12 · Particle-count refinement
entries.prompt: Increase particle count and test sampling convergence.
entries.change: Increased statistical sampling at fixed emitted mass. Two-seed daily-field differences fell to 8.42%; not all convergence criteria passed.
entries.after: Sampling noise reduced; criteria not all met
entries.limitation: 5.53 to 353.89 million particles per realization at fixed physical emission mass. Two-seed daily-field differences fall to 8.42%, but successive-count field and receptor criteria still fail.

entries.label: 13 · Vertical estimator refinement
entries.prompt: Increase vertical layers and test vertical convergence.
entries.change: Compared 13/26/52 vertical bins on shared paths. Finer vertical concentration profiles remained unconverged.
entries.before: Sampling noise reduced; criteria not all met
entries.limitation: 13, 26 and 52 layers with shared trajectories. The lowest layer is 6.25 m; 26-to-52-layer global and outlet profile changes exceed the declared limits. Fixed 0–25 m agreement is a common-volume consistency check.

entries.label: 14 · Transport timestep refinement
entries.prompt: Reduce timestep, test time convergence and preserve mass.
entries.change: Compared 120/60/30 s steps with paired increments. Process totals and receptors passed subcriteria; near-surface field differences remained 13.6%.
entries.after: Partial criteria pass; full-field criterion fails
entries.limitation: 120, 60 and 30 s with paired stochastic increments and fixed 120 s release events. Process totals and receptors meet their finest-step subcriteria; near-surface fields still differ by 13.6%.

entries.label: 15 · Terrain and surface exchange
entries.prompt: Include terrain interaction, prevent ground penetration, and model surface uptake and conditional re-release.
entries.change: Added actual DSM collision geometry, terrain-normal reflection and surface stores. Forecast re-release stayed zero; terrain GPU agreement failed.
entries.before: Partial criteria pass; full-field criterion fails
entries.after: CPU terrain scenario; new GPU agreement failed
entries.limitation: Actual bilinear DSM boundary, contact uptake and reversible/retained stores. Forecast re-release is zero under the assumed wetness gate. The CPU case has only 345,600 primary particles; previous higher-count convergence does not qualify it. Surface chemistry is uncalibrated; wind is not terrain-resolved.

entries.label: 16 · High-count CPU delivery
entries.prompt: Increase sampling for the terrain case and preserve every hourly native field.
entries.change: A separate same-physics CPU realization increased the terrain case from 345,600 to 353,894,400 primary particles. All 360 hourly fields were saved. This does not establish local convergence.
entries.limitation: Separate realization; 7,249 collision-limit truncations disclosed. This is not another item in the original 15-prompt experiment.

entries.label: 17 · Vancouver-model revision
entries.prompt: Use the Vancouver transport and thermal-plume workflow for Hangzhou; allow the original CPU weather route after validating continuation.
entries.change: Replaced the custom horizontally repeated forecast-column model with original-native 3D weather and continuous native transport plus GPU source-hour plume tables. The complete 360-hour result uses four conditional outlets.
entries.before: Custom terrain particle model; horizontally uniform forecast profiles
entries.after: Native 3D weather + native transport + parameterized plume rise
entries.limitation: Different physical workflow: a visual comparison is not a controlled solver-error or convergence test. The failed GPU 2 mm rain comparisons remain preserved; the authorized CPU route was used.

entries.label: 18 · Citywide source coverage
entries.prompt: Find all Hangzhou pollution sources, not only one source or the existing outlet subset.
entries.change: Collected 369 official air-emission priority candidates and permit leads. They are not 369 verified SO2 sources. Source coordinates, active operation and emission rates remain incomplete; these candidates were not added to the saved simulation.
entries.before: Four conditional EIA outlets in Linjiang
entries.after: Same four-outlet fields + a wider research inventory
entries.limitation: No new citywide concentration result or before/after movie exists. The playable film remains the explicitly labeled native four-outlet result.

entries.label: 19 · Ground queries and display repair
entries.prompt: Check near-ground values, retain native queries and repair the near-source display.
entries.change: Added native 0–20 m ground statistics and reviewed plume extent/source binding. These are query and presentation changes; the native physical fields and recorded film were not recomputed.
entries.after: Same result with additional statistics and display checks
entries.limitation: The existing film documents the recorded result, not a newly rendered before/after of every interface repair. See the current Scientific page for the actual ground query.
